assign.title: Sessions: voice falls back to OpenRouter on a Claude login failure too
assign.outcome:
**Voice sessions now switch to OpenRouter on a Claude login failure, not just a usage-limit refusal.**

- [x] treat auth failure like a usage refusal, switch at once, one short line to the owner: `Sessions.js`'s `woken()` now checks `AUTH_FAIL_RE`/`AUTH_FAIL_WORDS` (expired login, invalid key, 401, "please run /login") alongside the existing usage-limit check, says "Claude logged out; switched..." in the session itself — [prove-auth-fallback-results.txt](prove-auth-fallback-results.txt), case 2.
- [x] one AI-inbox card on auth failure, once (not per call), with the fix: posted via `servex.cards.create`, gated by an instance flag so a second failure in the same run posts no second card — same proof, case 3.
- [x] proved with a stubbed auth error: [prove-auth-fallback.mjs](prove-auth-fallback.mjs), modeled on the existing `prove-fallback.mjs`; `Sessions.test.mjs` still 13/13, `prove-fallback.mjs` (usage-limit path) unchanged.
